source_text: ΠΕΡΙ ΤΗΣ ΕΝ ΠΝΕΥΜΑΤΙ ΚΑΙ ΑΛΗΘΕΙΑ ΠΡΟΣΚΥΝΗΣΕΩΣ ΚΑΙ ΛΑΤΡΕΙΑΣ ΛΟΓΟΣ ΤΕΣΣΑΡΑΚΛΙΔΕΚΑΤΟΣ Ὅτι χρὴ τοὺς φοιτᾷν ἐθέλοντας ἐν ἐκκλησίαις, καθαροὺς καὶ ἐκνενιμμένους εἶναι τὴν ἐξ ἁμαρτίας κηλίδα, καὶ οὕτω παρίστασθαι τῷ Θεῷ. Σκηνῆς μὲν οὖν πέρι καὶ μέν τοι καὶ περὶ ἱερέων καὶ Λευιτικῆς ὑπουργίας διαρκέστατά μοι ταῦτα λελέχθαι φαίνεται, καὶ λεπτῶς διεσκέφθαι δοκῶ. Πρέ
pass_a_gloss: Title: Concerning the worship and service in Spirit and truth, Book Fourteen. Summary: That it is necessary for those wishing to frequent the churches to be clean and washed out (perf. ptc) as to the stain from sin, and thus to stand before God. Cyril: About the tent/tabernacle, then, and indeed also about priests and the Levitical ministry, these things seem to me to have been said most sufficiently, and I think I have examined them finely. It would befit (word broken at PG column 885 888)…
pass_b_english: ON ADORATION AND WORSHIP IN SPIRIT AND TRUTH — BOOK FOURTEEN. That those who wish to attend the churches must be clean, washed of the stain that sin leaves, and so present themselves before God.
Cyril: I think I have now said quite enough about the tabernacle, and also about the priests and the service of the Levites, and I believe I have examined these matters closely. It would be fitting…

apparatus.note: Migne PG 68 print; the column break may cut a sentence or a word.

Section ends mid-word: Πρέ|ποι runs into section 2. The English breaks at 'It would be fitting…' so that each section covers only its own Greek; the sentence continues at the start of section 2. The opening Greek paragraph holds the book title, the chapter summary and Cyril's first words; the English splits title+summary from Cyril's turn, as in the other books. 'ἐκκλησίαι' kept as 'churches' in the summary (Cyril's own application); in the Deuteronomy quotation later the same word is 'assembly'.
